title: Class 4 spheres seen only during restricted government activities

tellings.quote: Um, class 4 is a sphere. Um, we only saw this several years in a row, when we saw class 4.

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs and sorts what it sees into numbered classes, says its "Class 4" object is a sphere that shows up only during restricted government activities. The team tells Michels, as people who say they saw it, that "class 4 is a sphere" and that they saw it several years in a row, always at such government events. If true, it would tie this kind of object to secret official activity.
